Staged by the owner: V1 = map, agents, real status and tasks, scoreboard, feed, gates, tap, ask, reusing existing shared state. Owner constraint restated in the directive: do not spend a week building a video game while revenue is 0; return to revenue work after V1. Also mandates a single observer-UI owner (requirement 30) and a permission preflight (requirement 31).
